title: The Hawk and Azure Wood Canon
summary: A canon of high diving limbs of qi and soaring guards that ends in a descent of hawkwood from above.

title: Treatise of the Twin Heartwood
summary: A treatise on two trunks of qi that share one core and mend as hard as they strike and can restart a stilled heart.

title: The Basin Spring Tree Mastery
summary: A mastery of a tree that gathers clean water qi in its basin and pours it out as tonic and purge.

title: Manual of the Paired Blossom Cut
summary: A manual of blossoms that open in pairs and cut as they fall and close on a veil of petals.

title: The River Crossing Willow Treatise
summary: A treatise on the willow that bends over running water and the weeping flood it lets loose at the last.

title: Canon of the Azure Bloom Unbroken
summary: A canon of the azure bloom that keeps opening through every blow and ends in one full flowering.

title: The Oath-Wind Pine Canon
summary: A canon of the wind-sworn pine whose needles ride the gale and hold the oath of the line.

title: Treatise of the Plateau Gale Bough
summary: A treatise on the bough that stands on the open plateau and swings with the gale that scours it.

title: The Open Sky Oath Tree Manual
summary: A manual of the lone oath tree that grows with nothing around it to hide behind and takes its strength from the open sky.

title: The Bearing Wind Cedar Compendium
summary: A compendium of the cedar that keeps a fixed bearing in the wind and cleanses what it touches.

title: Canon of the Wind-Sworn Bamboo
summary: A canon of the sworn bamboo that bows to every gust and springs back to cut.

title: The Windward Root Reckoning
summary: A reckoning of roots that run windward and hold against any gale and pull strength from the ground.
